title: Modules and visibility: mod, pub, use and files
hints: Fix the compile errors from the top. A failed import of `koan::inventory` means the file isn't part of the crate yet; E0603 '… is private' names the exact item that needs `pub`.

In src/lib.rs: declare the file module (public), make the `pricing` module and the functions the checks call `pub`, and re-export `Item` with `pub use`. In src/inventory.rs: `new` and the `name` field need `pub`; `count` stays private.
`checkout` lives in `pricing::discounts`, so the parent module's `with_tax` is `super::with_tax`. Do the multiplication in u64: `unit_cents * quantity as u64`.

Same shapes on other data: `pub mod net;` (code in src/net.rs) · `pub mod audio { pub fn beep() {} pub(crate) fn reset() {} }` · `pub use net::Client;` · `pub fn total(&self) -> u64 { super::shipping::fee(self.weight) + self.price }`
